title: A full-screen Retina recording keeps up while it plays
goal: Playing a full-screen Retina recording at Next defaults shows a frame that is up to half a second old at most moments, so the picture sticks and jumps instead of moving smoothly. A smaller recording plays smoothly on the same machine. Make the big recording keep up too, so playback never stutters.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-10-07 by the manager pass on the probe built 12:19 from HEAD 8cfad4ee, machine load 2.6 on 16 cores:
  Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build playing-a-recording-never-blinks-walk  (three runs)
  -> 'played 3.0s (3456x2234), looked 24 times ... 15 caught a frame still being read and held one 9 frame(s) back instead' (12:36 rotating check)
  -> '21 caught a frame still being read and held one 18 frame(s) back instead'
  -> '19 caught a frame still being read and held one 15 frame(s) back instead'
Control, same machine, also behind other apps: a scratch walk (/tmp/mgr-walks/talk-playback-lag.json: openSampleTalk, expectPlaybackNeverBlank 3 s, 24 moments) on the 1280x800 talk sample read every frame in time, twice. So it is the frame size, not the probe being in the background.
History: playing-a-recording-never-blinks (done) shipped hold-the-last-frame plus 4 decoders per recording, 8 ahead, at canvas size, and left rough 'a frame can still be up to ~3 frames late under load'. It is now 9 to 18 frames late in most looks, so something has slowed since (check whether frames are still read at the canvas size the window shows, whether the decoder count and look-ahead survived the editor path becoming the default, and whether the new panel or timeline work competes for the main actor during playback). The lateness counter is checkPlaybackNeverBlank in Sources/Photonz/Playtest/PlaytestHarness.swift ~9060-9125 (frameIndexToShow in MovieFramesInHand). The walk only reports lateness today; making it fail is part of this task.
Focus success line: 'Playback of a full-screen Retina recording never blinks or stutters'. Renderer change: include a perf note in the commit.
acceptance: playing-a-recording-never-blinks-walk reports 'every frame was read before the playhead reached it', or at most 2 of 24 looks late and never more than 2 frames behind, in three runs in a row with the probe behind other apps
The walk fails (not just says) when more than 2 of its looks are late or any look is more than 2 frames behind, so a regression turns it red
an-editing-session-walk and the scrubbing walks stay green, and a 1280x800 recording still reads every frame in time

Try path at Next defaults: open the fixture 'Full screen Retina recording 3456x2234.mp4', press Space, and the picture moves smoothly from the first second. Audit written under queue/audits/ with the before and after numbers
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
